title: Hostinger evidence publisher unique workflow identity

phases.objective: Assign the specialized Hostinger workflow_run publisher a unique internal workflow identity so GitHub registers it independently while preserving its permissions, artifact identity, PR resolution, comment authority, and runtime safety boundary.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The specialized Hostinger publisher workflow, routing contract, and static contract test
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Exactly one specialized publisher is registered as Hostinger Canonical Evidence PR Publisher and retains the workflow_run trigger, trusted-main checkout, run-bound artifact download, exact PR identity validation, and bounded authoritative-comment update contract.
steps: Change the publisher workflow name from Hostinger CI Evidence PR Publisher to Hostinger Canonical Evidence PR Publisher.
Preserve the completed workflow_run trigger for Hostinger Storage Tenant Canary Guard.
Update ci-evidence routing and static regression expectations to the unique publisher name.
Run the specialized publisher normalization and comment-upsert regression suite.
assertions: The unique workflow name is Hostinger Canonical Evidence PR Publisher.
The trigger remains workflow_run completed for Hostinger Storage Tenant Canary Guard only.
Permissions remain actions:read, contents:read, issues:write, and pull-requests:write.
The publisher checks out trusted main with persist-credentials:false.
Routing references the unique publisher name for both the specialized publisher registry and Tenant Canary route.
No PR-head code receives comment-write authority.
No provider, credential, SQL, migration, deployment, Production, protected-branch, or force-push action occurs.

phases.objective: After merge, complete a new exact-head Tenant Canary run and prove Hostinger Canonical Evidence PR Publisher writes the Hostinger section to the shared authoritative PR comment.
blockers: The unique publisher workflow identity has not reached main yet.
No post-identity-change workflow_run publication has been observed.

phases.objective: Prove idempotent publisher retries and rejection of stale, ambiguous, malformed, missing-artifact, and mismatched-workflow evidence.
This change registers a repository evidence publisher and does not execute a live Hostinger canary.
The publisher grants no runtime, deployment, migration, provider, or Production authority.
